title: Accelerating Langevin Monte Carlo via Efficient Stochastic Runge--Kutta Methods beyond Log-Concavity
summary: Sampling from a high-dimensional probability distribution is a fundamental algorithmic task arising in wide-ranging applications across multiple disciplines, including scientific computing, computational statistics and machine learning. Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) algorithms are among the most widely used sampling methods in high-dimensional settings. This paper introduces a novel higher-order and Hessian-free LMC sampling algorithm based on an efficient stochastic Runge--Kutta method of strong order $1.5$ for the overdamped Langevin dynamics.
